restated: An adversary with existing access to Windows hosts on this network is stealing credentials from those hosts.
what_would_confirm: Observable evidence such as LSASS process memory access (e.g., via Mimikatz or procdump), suspicious access to SAM/SECURITY registry hives, NTDS.dit extraction, credential dumping tool execution, or anomalous authentication events indicating credential theft.
what_would_refute: Absence of credential dumping tool execution, no unauthorized access to LSASS or credential stores, no suspicious registry hive or NTDS.dit access, and no anomalous authentication events consistent with stolen credentials.
